propositions: Event bodies containing live credentials (API keys, tokens, PEM keys) are written to the append-only store and auto-pushed without content screening, causing GitHub push protection to reject the branch and wedge all concurrent agent writes.

The write seam is not `append_event` alone; the reconciler's inbound translate writes untrusted Jira-sourced COMMENT/EDIT bodies by calling finalize_event's halves directly, bypassing append_event validation.

A deterministic, pure secret screen must be enforced at `_seam.finalize_event` (the common seam for append_event, txn/delete cores, and reconciler inbound translate) with a force override recorded as an auditable event attribute.
Refused writes must name the matched secret family and field+line without echoing the secret value, payload keys, or fragments into exception messages, logs, or stored events.
Benign look-alikes (truncated placeholders, regex literals, prose enumerating patterns) must not be refused to keep the screen safe to leave on by default.
The command-substitution hazard that produced the incident and the blast radius (153 queued commits, full store-sharing outage) must be documented in user guide and incident record.
